name: english-reader-app
description: AI-powered English reading learning app with word translation, sentence analysis, and smart review

scripts.build: vite build --mode public && node scripts/release-artifact.mjs --dir www --flavor public && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:private-qa: vite build --mode private-qa && node scripts/release-artifact.mjs --dir www --flavor private-qa && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:private-qa && node scripts/build-apk.js --flavor private-qa
scripts.lexicon:verify: npm run lexicon:fetch && npm run lexicon:build
scripts.oewn:verify: npm run oewn:fetch && npm run oewn:build
scripts.release:preflight: npm run security:audit && npm run exam-focus:verify && npm run exam-corpus:verify && npm run lexicon:verify && npm run oewn:verify && npm run track-baseline:verify
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:preflight && npm run version:patch && npm run build:apk
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:preflight && npm run version:minor && npm run build:apk

author: Wang Xiaoming
